title: Australia Medical, Digital Health & Career Transition Pathways
purpose: A pathway catalogue for comparing clinical, digital-health, AI, research, and broader career-transition options for an internationally trained physician.
important_notice: This catalogue is for exploration, not a determination of visa eligibility, medical registration, specialist recognition, or employment eligibility. Requirements change. Verify each case against the linked official regulator, visa instrument, state nomination, university, and employer sources before making decisions.

pathway_groups.name: Clinical Medicine
pathway_groups.description: Continue practising medicine in Australia, with routes depending on qualifications, training, specialist status, and registration requirements.

pathways.title: Overseas-Trained Physician / Specialist Assessment
pathways.summary: Seek assessment of overseas specialist qualifications and training through the relevant Australian specialist college and Medical Board pathways.
typical_steps: Identify the relevant specialist college and pathway for the exact specialty.
Collect primary-source evidence of medical degree, internship, residency, specialist training, board examinations, and specialist certification.
Submit the required college assessment and meet any comparability, supervision, examination, or workplace-based requirements.
Meet Medical Board/Ahpra registration requirements and secure an appropriate supervised or approved position where required.
iran_specific_evidence: Iranian internal medicine residency completion evidence
Iranian written specialist board examination result
Iranian oral specialist board examination result
Detailed rotations, logbooks, references, and employment history
key_uncertainties: The outcome depends on individual training and evidence; an Iranian specialist certificate is not automatically equivalent to Australian specialist recognition.
College assessment and medical registration are separate processes.
Do not assume a particular examination or supervision outcome before formal assessment.

pathways.title: AMC Standard Pathway
pathways.summary: A route for eligible international medical graduates seeking general registration through the AMC assessment process and the required supervised practice pathway.
typical_steps: Check primary-source qualification verification and AMC eligibility requirements.
Complete the applicable AMC examinations or assessment route.
Meet the required supervised practice and workplace requirements.
Apply for the appropriate Medical Board registration.
key_uncertainties: The precise sequence depends on current AMC and Medical Board rules.
Passing AMC assessments does not itself guarantee a job, visa, or registration.

pathways.title: Hospital Non-Training / Service Medical Roles
pathways.summary: Explore service, resident, or hospital medical officer positions where the applicant meets the employer's and regulator's requirements.
typical_steps: Establish the registration pathway and permissible scope of practice.
Review state health-service recruitment criteria and credentialing requirements.
Prepare an Australian-style CV, referee list, and evidence of clinical experience.
Apply only to roles for which registration and work-right requirements can be met.
key_uncertainties: Job title does not establish registration eligibility.
Employer credentialing, visa sponsorship, and registration are distinct checks.

pathway_groups.name: Digital Health & Medical Software
pathway_groups.description: Build, implement, evaluate, or manage software used by clinicians, hospitals, patients, and health systems.

pathways.title: Clinical Informatics
pathways.summary: Use clinical knowledge and information systems expertise to improve clinical workflows, records, decision support, and health-system operations.
key_uncertainties: Role titles and required qualifications vary widely by employer; some roles require substantial IT implementation experience.

pathways.title: Medical Software / HealthTech Developer
pathways.summary: Develop applications and software products for clinical, hospital, patient, or healthcare-business use cases.
portfolio_projects: Appointment and follow-up platform using synthetic data
Clinical documentation tool with audit trail
key_uncertainties: A medical degree alone is not a substitute for software engineering skills; hiring typically requires demonstrable coding ability.

pathways.title: HealthTech Product Management
pathways.summary: Translate clinical needs into product requirements and coordinate design, engineering, implementation, evaluation, and adoption.
portfolio_projects: Product requirements document for a clinical app
entry_routes: Clinical subject-matter expert role in a technology company
key_uncertainties: Product roles often require prior product delivery experience; a clinical background is an advantage but not a guarantee.

pathway_groups.name: AI & Medical AI
pathway_groups.description: Apply machine learning and language technologies to healthcare problems, with a strong emphasis on evaluation, safety, and clinical validity.

pathways.title: Clinical AI Research
pathways.summary: Conduct research on AI methods and their performance, safety, bias, and clinical usefulness in healthcare.
portfolio_projects: Retrospective model evaluation on a public dataset
key_uncertainties: Research roles may require publications, formal quantitative training, or postgraduate research qualifications.

pathways.title: Medical LLM / AI Application Builder
pathways.summary: Build clinician-facing or patient-facing prototypes using language models, retrieval, structured data, and safety controls.
portfolio_projects: Medical knowledge RAG with cited source passages
Clinical note summarisation prototype using synthetic data
AI answer evaluation benchmark with error taxonomy
safety_requirements: Clearly label prototypes as non-clinical unless appropriately validated and authorised.
Use synthetic or appropriately licensed de-identified data.
Measure hallucinations, omissions, bias, and unsafe recommendations.
Do not deploy patient-care decision support without appropriate clinical, privacy, and regulatory review.
key_uncertainties: A working demo does not establish clinical safety, regulatory compliance, or employability as an AI engineer.

official_sources.name: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner

pathways.title: Health Data Science / Analytics
pathways.summary: Analyse health datasets to support service planning, quality improvement, research, and decision-making.
portfolio_projects: Hospital activity dashboard using public data
key_uncertainties: Data scientist roles often require stronger statistics, programming, and modelling experience than analyst roles.

official_sources.name: Australian Institute of Health and Welfare

pathway_groups.name: Research, Academia & Public Health
pathway_groups.description: Use medical training in research, epidemiology, clinical trials, health services, or population health.

pathways.title: PhD in Digital Health / Biomedical Informatics / Medical AI
pathways.summary: Undertake supervised research at a university in digital health, clinical AI, biomedical informatics, or health data science.
possible_outcomes: Research fellow (subject to qualifications and experience)
typical_steps: Identify a suitable research group and supervisor.
Check entry requirements and English-language requirements.
Assess scholarships and funding separately from admission.
Confirm research ethics and data-access feasibility.
key_uncertainties: Admission, scholarship award, stipend, and visa eligibility are separate decisions.
A PhD does not automatically lead to permanent employment or migration eligibility.

official_sources.name: Australian Government Department of Education - RTP

pathways.title: Clinical Epidemiology / Public Health
pathways.summary: Apply clinical knowledge to population health, epidemiology, outcomes research, health policy, and evidence synthesis.
key_uncertainties: Professional titles and roles may have specific qualification or experience requirements.

official_sources.name: Australian Institute of Health and Welfare

pathway_groups.name: Broader Career Transition
pathway_groups.description: Move beyond healthcare-specific roles into the wider technology sector. These options require building a competitive non-medical skill set.

pathways.title: Software Engineering
key_uncertainties: Competitive entry-level market; a medical degree does not replace demonstrable engineering competence.

pathways.title: Machine Learning Engineering
key_uncertainties: Usually a higher technical barrier than using existing AI APIs; formal quantitative training or substantial project evidence may be expected.

pathways.title: Technical Product Management
key_uncertainties: Prior product delivery experience is commonly important.

visa_and_migration_checklist.rule: Never infer visa eligibility from a pathway title. Match the actual duties, occupation classification, skills assessment authority, current occupation list/instrument, state criteria, salary rules, employer sponsorship requirements, and applicant circumstances.
required_checks: Exact occupation and ANZSCO/OSCA classification where applicable
Current legislative instrument and eligible occupation list
Relevant skills assessment authority and assessment criteria
Points, English, age, work-experience, and qualification requirements where applicable
State or territory nomination criteria where applicable
Employer sponsorship, salary, and work-experience requirements where applicable
Medical registration and scope-of-practice requirements for clinical work

iranian_specialist_training_profile.description: Keep Iranian specialist-training milestones separate from Australian licensing and college assessment milestones.
iranian_specialist_training_profile.warning: Iranian board examinations and specialist certification are evidence for an overseas qualification assessment; they are not AMC examinations and do not automatically confer Australian specialist recognition or registration.

preferred_sources: RACP and other relevant specialist colleges
source_policy.maintenance: Review visa instruments, occupation lists, regulator standards, and university admissions pages before each release.

strategy_interpretation.beginner: Assume no substantial prior programming experience. Start with practical foundations and avoid making advanced coding a prerequisite for every pathway.
strategy_interpretation.fast: Prioritise the shortest credible route to a first relevant role, early portfolio evidence, and parallel exploration of clinical and non-clinical options. Do not imply guaranteed or instant employment.
strategy_interpretation.all: Keep self-study, short courses, graduate certificates, master's degrees, and PhD routes open. Compare each by time, cost, entry requirements, funding, and career outcome.

personalized_strategy.north_star: Run two tracks in parallel: (1) preserve and assess the clinical-specialist option, and (2) build a fast-entry digital-health/health-tech profile from beginner level. Add deeper formal study only when it materially improves access to a target role.

priority_order.why: The user's internal medicine training and Iranian specialist-board milestones may be valuable evidence. Preserve this option while obtaining formal advice/assessment; do not assume Australian recognition.
near_term_actions: Organise medical degree, internship, residency, rotations, logbooks, written and oral Iranian board results, specialist certificate status, and references.
Map the exact specialist assessment and registration requirements with the relevant college and Medical Board.
Keep AMC Standard Pathway as a separately assessed alternative rather than conflating it with specialist recognition.

priority_order.why: This uses clinical domain knowledge without requiring the user to become an advanced software engineer before applying for adjacent roles.
target_roles: Digital Health Implementation or Project Officer
first_skills: Requirements writing and user acceptance testing
portfolio: A clinical workflow map and requirements document
A small synthetic-data patient or hospital dashboard
A simple FHIR demo showing how clinical resources are represented

priority_order.why: A clinically informed portfolio can be developed early using APIs and existing tools, while deeper ML engineering is treated as a later specialisation.
target_roles: AI Product or Clinical Solutions Associate
Junior LLM Application Developer (after demonstrable coding practice)
first_skills: Privacy, data governance, and clinical safety
portfolio: A medical knowledge assistant that cites source passages
A structured evaluation set testing accuracy, omissions, and unsafe outputs
A clinical note summarisation prototype using synthetic data only
priority_order.guardrail: Do not use real patient-identifiable data in portfolio projects. Do not present prototypes as validated clinical decision support.

priority_order.track: Formal education as an accelerator, not an automatic first step
priority_order.why: The user is open to every level of study, but the fast priority means selecting education only after identifying the target role and checking whether it is required or offers a clear advantage.

options.best_for: Testing fit and building initial skills at low cost
Targeted gaps, practical evidence, and structured learning
A more formal transition credential when employers or roles value it
Structured career transition, specialist knowledge, networks, or roles with postgraduate expectations
A research-led career in clinical AI, biomedical informatics, digital health, or epidemiology

priority_order.decision_rule: Before enrolling, compare total cost, duration, admission prerequisites, scholarship availability, work rights/visa implications, graduate outcomes, and whether the qualification is actually requested in relevant job advertisements.

deliverables: Set up GitHub and a clean project repository
Learn basic Python syntax and notebooks
Write a one-page clinical workflow problem statement
Build a small dashboard using synthetic or public data
Document the problem, data source, limitations, and screenshots
Practise Git commits and a clear README
Build a small API-based medical knowledge prototype
Add citations and a test set
Document failure modes and safety limitations
Create a clinical-digital CV and LinkedIn profile
Analyse 20 relevant Australian job advertisements for recurring requirements
Tailor the portfolio to the 2-3 most frequent skill gaps
Apply selectively to entry/adjacent roles while continuing clinical pathway assessment

weekly_time_allocation.note: This is a starting allocation, not a fixed requirement. Increase formal exam or specialist-assessment preparation when dates and eligibility are confirmed.

decision_gates: After 4 weeks: decide whether coding is engaging enough to continue toward developer roles or whether clinical systems/product roles are a better fast-entry fit.
After 8 weeks: assess whether the portfolio demonstrates practical ability, not just course completion.
After 12 weeks: use real job-ad requirements and feedback to choose between direct applications, a targeted short course, a graduate qualification, or a research degree.
avoid: Starting with advanced machine learning or deep learning before Python, statistics, and software basics.
Enrolling immediately in an expensive master's or PhD without a defined target role and funding/visa analysis.
Assuming a medical degree alone qualifies someone for software engineering or AI engineering jobs.
Treating any non-clinical job title as automatically eligible for a skilled visa.
Abandoning the clinical pathway before obtaining a realistic formal assessment.
